fact: Four payment institutions held BCEAO licences in Benin as of 31 August 2026 (Julaya Benin and Open SI in September 2025, FedaPay Benin on 2 April 2026, QOS Integrated Center Benin on 24 July 2026), per the BCEAO list published on 8 October 2026.
title: Benin: four licensed payment institutions as of August 2026
